t: This is Bridgewater House, a grand townhouse at 14 Cleveland Row in St James's. It's Grade I listed and was designed by Sir Charles Barry, best known for rebuilding the Palace of Westminster and for bringing the Italian palazzo style to British city mansions. Francis Egerton, the first Earl of Ellesmere, a politician, writer, traveller and patron of the arts, lived here. Later the house passed to several Dukes of Sutherland, including the third, fourth and sixth. Barbara Palmer, Duchess of Cleveland, the notorious mistress of Charles the Second, is also recorded as an owner.
